_doc: #1543 The Claude model catalogue served by GET /ai/usage (claude_tokens.families / .models), so the SuperApp badge and the SuperIntel Cost page learn model names at runtime (nothing baked into an APK). A transcript model id belongs to the first family whose `match` prefix it starts with; anything else is 'other'. Prices are USD per MTok (Anthropic first-party rates; cache_write = 5-minute tier); the per-day cost itself is computed on the posting host by `my-ai usage` from da_my-ai/data/pricing.json, these are shown for reference.
